expect_red: model: the tint verb takes each part's body colour as part=#rrggbb, or off, and refuses a malformed pair

mutations.contract: `model tint off` puts every part back to its own colour.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_dag_is_coloured_by_a_chosen_attribute_and_spaced_to_taste (2026-11-05). off parsed as a pair and refused: the shell could never take the body colour off.
mutations.find: if (list.length === 2 && list[1] === "off") return { action: action, tints: null };
